verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents first-party webhooks. When something changes, such as a feature flag update, it sends an HTTP POST payload to the webhook's configured URL, so a programmatic consumer can receive change events. The docs also describe using webhooks to drive external systems such as issue trackers and support tickets. Missing for 10: documented detail on per-event-type subscription filtering, payload signing/verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When something changes, like when a feature flag is updated... LaunchDarkly sends an HTTP POST payload to the webhook's configured URL.
Use webhooks to update external issue trackers, update support tickets, notify customers of new feature rollouts, and more.
